title: Utilization
description: Fleet-wide GPU use with a table of nodes to inspect, TPU VMs held, and the selected node: its jobs, their requests, and what the node and each attempt used. Two fleet queries per load; three more once a node is selected.

list.name: bin
list.label: Bin
list.description: At least 2 minutes: node agent samples arrive about every 60.7 s, so a 1-minute bin can miss one.

list.label: Node
list.description: Set by clicking a node in Nodes to inspect, or typed.

panels.title: GPUs held and busy per cluster
panels.description:
Per ${bin}, per CoreWeave cluster. GPUs held are the GPUs that reported inventory in a bin (a GPU present for part of the bin counts fully); GPUs busy and tensor-active are the sums of each GPU's mean ratio over its samples in the bin. The same query feeds Nodes to inspect; the bridge runs it once.

SQL ({{from}} and {{to}} are the dashboard time range; the bridge fills them in.):

```sql
WITH gpu AS ( SELECT "cluster", node_name,  date_bin(INTERVAL ${bin:sqlstring}, to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms), TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01 00:00:00') AS bin,  json_get(attributes_json, 'gpu_uuid') AS gpu_uuid,  max(CASE WHEN name = 'hardware_inventory' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS held,  max(CASE WHEN name = 'hardware_inventory' THEN json_get(attributes_json, 'gpu_model') END) AS gpu_model,  avg(CASE WHEN name = 'gpu_sm_active_ratio' THEN value END) AS sm_active,  avg(CASE WHEN name = 'gpu_tensor_active_ratio' THEN value END) AS tensor_active FROM "telemetry_v1.node_agent" WHERE service = 'iris-node-agent' AND name IN ('hardware_inventory', 'gpu_sm_active_ratio', 'gpu_tensor_active_ratio') AND json_get(attributes_json, 'gpu_uuid') IS NOT NULL AND "cluster" IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4 HAVING date_bin(INTERVAL ${bin:sqlstring}, to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms), TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01 00:00:00') + INTERVAL ${bin:sqlstring} <= {{to}}) SELECT "cluster", node_name, bin, sum(held) AS gpus_held, sum(COALESCE(sm_active, 0)) AS gpus_busy,  sum(COALESCE(tensor_active, 0)) AS gpus_tensor_active, max(gpu_model) AS gpu_model FROM gpu GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY 3, 1, 2
```

panels.title: Nodes to inspect
panels.description:
One row per GPU node in the range: its GPU type, and GPUs held, busy and tensor-active averaged over the range's bins. GPUs held are the GPUs that reported inventory in a bin (a GPU present for part of the bin counts fully); GPUs busy and tensor-active are the sums of each GPU's mean ratio over its samples in the bin. Idle GPUs are held minus busy; sorted by idle GPUs. Rack, slot, node pool, instance type and IB fabric come from the Kubernetes node labels (/k8s/nodes, which needs the CoreWeave read token). Click a node to show it in the Node section below.

SQL ({{from}} and {{to}} are the dashboard time range; the bridge fills them in.):

```sql
WITH gpu AS ( SELECT "cluster", node_name,  date_bin(INTERVAL ${bin:sqlstring}, to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms), TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01 00:00:00') AS bin,  json_get(attributes_json, 'gpu_uuid') AS gpu_uuid,  max(CASE WHEN name = 'hardware_inventory' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS held,  max(CASE WHEN name = 'hardware_inventory' THEN json_get(attributes_json, 'gpu_model') END) AS gpu_model,  avg(CASE WHEN name = 'gpu_sm_active_ratio' THEN value END) AS sm_active,  avg(CASE WHEN name = 'gpu_tensor_active_ratio' THEN value END) AS tensor_active FROM "telemetry_v1.node_agent" WHERE service = 'iris-node-agent' AND name IN ('hardware_inventory', 'gpu_sm_active_ratio', 'gpu_tensor_active_ratio') AND json_get(attributes_json, 'gpu_uuid') IS NOT NULL AND "cluster" IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4 HAVING date_bin(INTERVAL ${bin:sqlstring}, to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms), TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01 00:00:00') + INTERVAL ${bin:sqlstring} <= {{to}}) SELECT "cluster", node_name, bin, sum(held) AS gpus_held, sum(COALESCE(sm_active, 0)) AS gpus_busy,  sum(COALESCE(tensor_active, 0)) AS gpus_tensor_active, max(gpu_model) AS gpu_model FROM gpu GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY 3, 1, 2
```

options.content: CPU and memory in use need a precomputed table: the live `iris.task` scan took 3 to 28 s at a 15-minute range on the hub (median 24 s over three runs), past the bridge's 20 s deadline.

Use by category needs the job tag column, which the controller does not write yet. Splitting by category joins every attempt to its job, the costly lookback, so it will likely come from a precomputed table rather than a live query.

panels.title: TPU VMs held
panels.description:
TPU VMs that reported inventory per ${bin}, per cluster and TPU type: distinct node_name, which on a TPU VM is its GCE instance name, one per worker of a multi-host slice. TPUs have no use signal; chips held is VMs times chips per VM of the type.

SQL ({{from}} and {{to}} are the dashboard time range; the bridge fills them in.):

```sql
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') AS "cluster", date_bin(INTERVAL ${bin:sqlstring}, to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms), TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01 00:00:00') AS bin, json_get(attributes_json, 'tpu_type') AS tpu_type, count(DISTINCT node_name) AS tpu_vms_held FROM "telemetry_v1.node_agent" WHERE service = 'iris-node-agent' AND name = 'hardware_inventory' AND json_get(attributes_json, 'device_kind') = 'tpu' AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 HAVING date_bin(INTERVAL ${bin:sqlstring}, to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms), TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01 00:00:00') + INTERVAL ${bin:sqlstring} <= {{to}} ORDER BY 1, 2, 3
```

panels.title: Jobs on the node
panels.description:
One line per job: 1 while an attempt of the job runs on ${node}, 0 otherwise, stacked so two jobs at once read 2. Attempts whose newest row is older than 1 day before the range start are missed. The same query feeds the attempts table; the bridge runs it once.

SQL ({{from}} and {{to}} are the dashboard time range; the bridge fills them in.):

```sql
WITH attempt AS ( SELECT "cluster", root_job_id, root_submitted_at_ms, job_id, submitted_at_ms, task_id, attempt_id, attempt_uid, state, started_at, finished_at FROM (  SELECT "cluster", root_job_id, root_submitted_at_ms, job_id, submitted_at_ms, task_id, attempt_id, attempt_uid, state, started_at, finished_at,   row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY attempt_uid ORDER BY ts DESC, seq DESC) AS rn  FROM "iris.controller_db__task_attempts"  WHERE ${node:sqlstring} <> '' AND (node_name = ${node:sqlstring} OR worker_id = ${node:sqlstring})   AND ts >= {{from}} - INTERVAL '1 day' AND ts < {{to}} ) WHERE rn = 1 AND started_at IS NOT NULL AND started_at < {{to}}   AND COALESCE(finished_at, {{to}}) > {{from}}), job AS (  SELECT "cluster", root_job_id, root_submitted_at_ms, job_id, submitted_at_ms, name FROM (  SELECT "cluster", root_job_id, root_submitted_at_ms, job_id, submitted_at_ms, name,   row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY "cluster", root_job_id, root_submitted_at_ms, job_id, submitted_at_ms ORDER BY ts DESC, seq DESC) AS rn  FROM "iris.controller_db__jobs"  WHERE ts >= {{from}} - INTERVAL '1 day' AND ts < {{to}}   AND root_job_id IN (SELECT root_job_id FROM attempt) ) WHERE rn = 1), request AS ( SELECT "cluster", root_job_id, root_submitted_at_ms, job_id, submitted_at_ms, res_cpu_millicores, res_memory_bytes, accelerator_kind, accelerator_type,  accelerators_per_task FROM (  SELECT "cluster", root_job_id, root_submitted_at_ms, job_id, submitted_at_ms, res_cpu_millicores, res_memory_bytes, accelerator_kind, accelerator_type,   accelerators_per_task,   row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY "cluster", root_job_id, root_submitted_at_ms, job_id, submitted_at_ms ORDER BY ts DESC, seq DESC) AS rn  FROM "iris.controller_db__job_config"  WHERE ts >= {{from}} - INTERVAL '1 day' AND ts < {{to}}   AND root_job_id IN (SELECT root_job_id FROM attempt) ) WHERE rn = 1), grid AS ( SELECT unnest(generate_series(date_bin(INTERVAL '1 minute', {{from}}, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01 00:00:00'),  {{to}}, INTERVAL '1 minute')) AS minute) SELECT g.minute, a.attempt_uid, a.task_id, a.attempt_id, a.job_id, j.name AS job_name, a.state,  a.started_at, a.finished_at, r.res_cpu_millicores / 1000.0 AS cpu_request,  r.res_memory_bytes AS memory_request_bytes, r.accelerator_kind, r.accelerator_type,  r.accelerators_per_task, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS category,  CASE WHEN a.started_at < g.minute + INTERVAL '1 minute'   AND COALESCE(a.finished_at, {{to}}) > g.minute THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS active FROM attempt a LEFT JOIN job j USING ("cluster", root_job_id, root_submitted_at_ms, job_id, submitted_at_ms) LEFT JOIN request r USING ("cluster", root_job_id, root_submitted_at_ms, job_id, submitted_at_ms) CROSS JOIN grid g WHERE g.minute < {{to}} ORDER BY g.minute, a.job_id, a.attempt_uid
```

panels.title: GPU SM-active per GPU

Per-minute SM-active ratio of each GPU on ${node} (CoreWeave nodes only).

```sql
SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '1 minute', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms), TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01 00:00:00') AS minute, name, json_get(attributes_json, 'gpu_index') AS gpu_index, avg(value) AS value FROM "telemetry_v1.node_agent" WHERE ${node:sqlstring} <> '' AND service = 'iris-node-agent' AND node_name = ${node:sqlstring} AND name IN ('gpu_sm_active_ratio', 'gpu_tensor_active_ratio', 'gpu_power_watts', 'node_cpu_utilization_percent', 'node_memory_used_bytes', 'node_memory_total_bytes') AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY 1, 2, 3
```

panels.title: CPU cores per attempt
panels.description:
Per-minute CPU cores each attempt on ${node} used, from iris.task.

SQL ({{from}} and {{to}} are the dashboard time range; the bridge fills them in.):

```sql
WITH attempt AS ( SELECT "cluster", task_id, attempt_id, started_at, finished_at FROM (  SELECT "cluster", task_id, attempt_id, attempt_uid, started_at, finished_at,   row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY attempt_uid ORDER BY ts DESC, seq DESC) AS rn  FROM "iris.controller_db__task_attempts"  WHERE ${node:sqlstring} <> '' AND (node_name = ${node:sqlstring} OR worker_id = ${node:sqlstring})   AND ts >= {{from}} - INTERVAL '1 day' AND ts < {{to}} ) WHERE rn = 1 AND started_at IS NOT NULL AND started_at < {{to}}   AND COALESCE(finished_at, {{to}}) > {{from}}) SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '1 minute', t.ts, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01 00:00:00') AS minute,  t.task_id || ':' || CAST(t.attempt_id AS VARCHAR) AS attempt,  avg(t.cpu_millicores) / 1000.0 AS cpu_cores, avg(t.memory_mb) * 1048576 AS memory_bytes FROM "iris.task" t JOIN attempt a  ON COALESCE(NULLIF(t."cluster", ''), 'marin') = a."cluster"  AND t.task_id = a.task_id AND t.attempt_id = a.attempt_id  AND t.ts >= a.started_at AND t.ts <= COALESCE(a.finished_at, {{to}}) WHERE t.ts >= {{from}} AND t.ts < {{to}}  AND t.task_id IN (SELECT task_id FROM attempt) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2
```
